svg.title: N0zoM1z0 · Contribution Arcade · 09 / CIVILIZATION
svg.desc: 13,956 GitHub contributions across 138 active days, 2025-10-12 to 2026-10-14. Actual accumulated contributions cross fixed era thresholds, growing a camp into a hamlet, village, town, industrial settlement and spaceport. Observed inactive runs weather and overgrow the settlement; activity repairs it.
